The button straddles the centre gap in columns 8 and 10 with its legs on rows f (top) and e (bottom). The column numbers are read from the picture, so they are approximate.
The exact rail hole numbers (tn.1 and tn.8) and the wire rows (10t.g, 8b.d) are read from the picture, so they are approximate. They sit in the right strips.
